sn21.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.1:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn21.1:1.5: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
sn21.1:2.2: idha mayhaṃ āvuso rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
sn21.1:2.6: “idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn21.1:2.8: so khvāhaṃ āvuso, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn21.1:2.9: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato vitakkasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn21.1:3.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
sn21.1:3.2: “moggallāna, moggallāna, mā brāhmaṇa ariyaṃ tuṇhībhāvaṃ pamādo. ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ saṇṭhāpehi. ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi. ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ samādahā”ti.
sn21.1:3.3: so khvāhaṃ āvuso, aparena samayena vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. yaṃ
sn21.1:3.4: hi taṃ āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
sn21.1:3.5: “satthārā anuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ patto”ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
